listing.name: Mario Party 6 (Starlit Party)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Starlit Party; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream reports boards/modes/ending but only49of81minigames playable. Boards skip unsupported games with a notice; incompleteness remains visible. Only49/81 minigames playable; unsupported boards minigames skipped with notice. Windows/Android/browser assets; browser iPhone route not iOS runtime binary. Upstream platforms: Windows, Android ARM64 and browser/iPhone WebGPU. Web ZIP is not a native iOS binary; other desktop hosts Unknown. Original data: GameCube MarioParty6 USA own disc/extracted files. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
